## EcclesiaOS v1.0.67

### Compact Website Studio section builder

- Added custom colour controls for Heading, Text, and Quote widgets.
- Added font size and alignment controls to Quote widgets for consistent typography editing.
- Reorganized widget settings into responsive, compact grids to reduce long vertical editor cards.
- Improved layouts for buttons, images, videos, cards, icons, dividers, events, sermons, spacers, carousels, sliders, and galleries.
- Added deletion controls for exact columns and complete stacked column groups.
- Protected the final remaining column and group, and added confirmation before deleting populated layouts.
- Simplified and tightened the column-group toolbar, labels, spacing, and helper text.

### Compatibility

- Existing widgets without custom colours continue to use their current website theme colours.
- Existing section and column data remains compatible.
- No database migration is required.

### Verification

- The Website Studio feature suite passes with 14 tests and 430 assertions.
- The release is verified with the complete PHP test suite, Composer validation and audit, npm audit, Pint, the production frontend build, and Git whitespace checks.
